tagline: Open a PDF and hear it read aloud. The file stays on this device.
description:
Open a PDF and this app reads it sentence by sentence. The page follows along, and the sentence you hear is marked.

The file stays on this device. It is not sent to a server. Close the app, come back, and you are on the same sentence.

The voice is the computer's Text → speech voice. Install Offline TTS from the store, keep it in Providers, and assign it to Text → speech in Settings. If no voice is installed, or the voice fails, the app says so. It does not substitute another sound.

A two-page public-domain note is already open the first time, so you can press Play before you pick a file of your own.

The pages are drawn by Mozilla's pdf.js, packed in. Unofficial — Mozilla did not bless this copy.
